entries.title: A second island
body: Past Simula Strait lies the desert. Build a raft at the Shore and sail to Sunscar Coast.
Cross the sand to the settlement of Sunscar Hollow. Burning ground drains HP outside the safe domes.
New desert monsters, gathering goods and the first Lv 100 gear are out there.
This is still an alpha: things may change or be reset.

entries.title: Soft launch
body: HozWorld is live at https://app.hozworld.com and on itch.io at https://syouske.itch.io/hozworld.
This is still an alpha: things may change, break or be reset.
Thanks for playing and sharing feedback.

entries.title: Nov 24, 2026
body: Quests now hand in at the characters themselves, out in the world
Desert fights use each map's own floor and scenery
Burning ground drains HP outside the safe domes, not during a fight
Safe domes grew from 5 x 5 to 15 x 15 tiles
The first Lv 100 gear: Sunscar boots, gloves and greaves
Monsters show their element by colour
Keyboard hotkeys work in the HD-2D fight view

entries.title: Nov 23, 2026
body: A raft crossing to the desert: Simula Strait, then Sunscar Coast
A crafted raft lasts 6 crossings
The desert route runs on to Scorched Flats, Salt Pan and Sunscar Hollow
Sprint into quicksand with a full stamina bar, or sink back
New desert monsters: Dune Mummy, Sand Scorpion and Carrion Vulture
New gathering goods: Brimstone, Saltwort and Cobalt, with two quests
Your first landing on Sunscar sets your save point

entries.title: Nov 21-22, 2026
body: HD-2D fights are now a setting for everyone in Graphics
Two new trait lines: Vitality and Wisdom
VIT points cost half as much (420 for 120 VIT, was 800)
Monster HP growth eased from 2.5 to 1.5
Mobs now remember where they last saw you and search there
Heroes gained new attack and cast motions
Wanderers wear class outfits and can roll the Priest class

entries.title: Nov 16-20, 2026
body: A new art look is on by default: trees, ground, nodes and orcs
The village was rebuilt, with huts around the square
Every NPC has new art with a gentle breathing idle
Forgot your password? Reset it by email code
Push and pull skills now also move your allies
Heroes can sprint, with new Adventurer and casual outfits
Monsters in the world draw with their new art again

entries.title: Oct 26, 2026
body: New start screen, loading art and music
Village music; only the 3 huts remain, with new trees and rocks
Trees, rocks and huts are now solid
Spotlight transition into fights
Riverlands, Frontier and Ashlands monsters are 30% stronger
HozPlayG is now HozWorld
